# costfluent_user (Data Source)

Look a member of the organization, or a pending invitation, up by email, for its ID in costfluent_team_member. People removed from the organization are not found. Needs an organization token with `viewMembers`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look a member's ID up by email
data "costfluent_user" "lena" {
  email = "lena@example.com"
}

resource "costfluent_team" "platform" {
  name = "Platform"
}

resource "costfluent_team_member" "lena_platform" {
  team_id = costfluent_team.platform.id
  user_id = data.costfluent_user.lena.id
  role    = "editor"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The member's email address, matched without regard to case.

### Read-Only

- `first_name` (String) First name.
- `id` (String) User ID.
- `joined_at` (String) When the member joined, or was invited.
- `last_name` (String) Last name.
- `role` (String) Organization role: owner, integrationOwner, editor or viewer.
- `status` (String) invited, active or suspended.
